payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array then perform greedy matching using amortized two-pointer to count maximum elements that can be placed over a smaller original.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables efficient matching of each element to a smaller unmatched element. Two-pointer/queue achieves linear time matching.
